## The two sites, read on `origin/main`

`.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md`:

- **`:63`** — the route-tree diagram: `└── /                                      → ConnectedShell + RootRedirect`
- **`:67`** — the list of importable published building blocks: `` `ConsoleShell`, `ConnectedShell`, `AuthenticatedRoute`, `RootRedirect`, `SystemRedirect`, … ``

## Why it is class (a): copying it fails

PR #10103 (ruling A′ on objectui#10042) **removes `RootRedirect`** from `packages/app-shell` and from its barrel — one implementation of `/`, and it is the console's guarded one. ⇒ once that lands, a reader who copies the `:67` import list gets a **compile error**, and the `:63` diagram describes a route tree the code no longer has.

⚠️ It is not stale-by-drift: it will be falsified **by a specific merge**, which is what makes it worth a card rather than a sweep. ⭐ It is also a `.claude/skills/**` guide — read by agents as well as by people — so 「a reader copies it」 is the ordinary case, ⛔ not the unlucky one.

## ⚠️ Routing, and why this seat applies no `domain:*`

⚠️ Whoever takes it: the governed landing path applies in full. ⛔ This seat does not merge it, ⛔ does not approve it, and ⛔ does not flip it ready.

- PR **#10103** is armed and in the queue at filing time. ⭐ **Re-read both sites when this card is taken**: if #10103 has not landed, the guide is still TRUE and a repair would be premature; if it has, the repair is owed.
- ⛔ Do not widen into the two pending changesets that also narrate `RootRedirect` (`.changeset/6507-boot-gate-redirect-splash.md`, `.changeset/7373-recovery-redirects-follow-declared-landing.md`). Those are another card's unreleased narrative, `check:changeset-claims` is report-only and green on them, and the successor is already named: the seat that versions the next release reads every pending changeset anyway.
- ⛔ Do not re-point `ROADMAP.md`'s historical 「RootRedirect update」 checkbox. It describes the 2025 change that CREATED the twin; re-pointing it would make it describe a tree it was never written about.

## Acceptance

- Both sites tell the truth about the tree at the moment of the fix: the diagram names the resolver that actually serves `/`, and the building-blocks list names only symbols the barrel exports.
- ⭐ The import list is checked against the barrel **mechanically** rather than by eye — if a gate that does this already exists, say which; if not, say so and ⛔ do not build one here (a new required gate is a maintainer-floor decision).
- ⛔ One governed file, one governed PR. ⛔ Nothing non-governed rides along.
